The '''Soco-Jarel system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]]<ref name="BlackSands">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref> of the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]]<ref name="EAOC Socorro">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="BlackSands" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Soco-Jarel [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-4.<ref name="TEA" />
